prompt: do a Reynolds-Averaged Simulation (RAS) pitzdaily simulation. Use PIMPLE algorithm. The domain is a 2D millimeter-scale channel geometry. Boundary conditions specify a fixed velocity of 15m/s at the inlet (left),fixed-value pressure of 0 at the outlet (right) with zero-gradient velocity there, and no-slip conditions for walls. Use timestep of 0.0001 and output every 0.01. Finaltime is 0.3. use nu value of 1e-04. Use the standard k-epsilon RAS model with k = 0.375 m^2/s^2 and epsilon = 14.855 m^2/s^3 at the inlet and as initial values, and standard wall functions (kqRWallFunction, epsilonWallFunction, nutkWallFunction) on upperWall and lowerWall. Do not use more than 13000 cells in your mesh.
adopted_interpretations: 源压力单位m2/s2，源无密度；为统一物理Pa输出，本移植公开补充density=1kg/m3，出口零压基准不变。
初始U=(0,0)按0/U，k与epsilon按源题；没有把入口速度当整个域初态。
原PIMPLE与dt=.0001为算法设置，本移植不绑定软件或内部步长。
源13000单元为网格预算，不伪装成已校准评测限制。
